items.name: screen_qa
items.description: ScreenQA dataset was introduced in the "ScreenQA: Large-Scale Question-Answer Pairs over Mobile App Screenshots" paper. It contains ~86K question-answer pairs collected by human annotators for ~35K screenshots from Rico. It should be used to train and evaluate models capable of screen content understanding via question answering.

items.name: Attributed-QA
items.description: We believe the ability of an LLM to attribute the text that it generates is likely to be crucial for both system developers and users in information-seeking scenarios. This release consists of human-rated system outputs for a new question-answering task, Attributed Question Answering (AQA).
